title: Topic 16: Free Time & Preferences - Reading
description: Two short texts with three questions each.
canDoStatement: Talk about hobbies, likes and dislikes

readingBlock.readingText:
TEXT A - Profile page format
CLUB PAGE - MEET OUR MEMBERS!
Name: Tina, 24, from Santos.
Hobbies: I swim every morning before work, and I play
the guitar at night. I don't watch TV - I don't like
it! On the weekend I sing with my friends at the park.
Favorite music: everything! I dance to all of it.
Do you like music too? Come to the club on Saturday!

TEXT B - Chat messages format
Nino: Gala! Do you play games at night?
Gala: No, I don't. At night I read - one book every
      week!
Nino: One book a WEEK?! I read one book a year...
Gala: Ha! But you swim and you dance, Nino. I don't
      do sport.
Nino: True! So: you read, I swim. On Saturday - film
      at my house? Do you like old films?
Gala: Yes, I do!!

readingQuestions.question: What does Tina do every morning?
Which sentence about Tina is TRUE?
options: Music is a very big part of her life
readingQuestions.correctAnswer: Music is a very big part of her life

readingQuestions.question: What do Nino and Gala talk about?
options: Their different hobbies + a film on Saturday
readingQuestions.correctAnswer: Their different hobbies + a film on Saturday

readingQuestions.question: Gala reads one book every week. Nino reads one book a year. What is true?
options: Gala reads much more than Nino
readingQuestions.correctAnswer: Gala reads much more than Nino
